data.content_ref: inline:The target erroneously claims that 'only the form p^6 * q^2 is possible', omitting the case where m = p^2 * q^6. Since 21 = 3 * 7, the prime factorization of m must be of the form p^{20} or p^2 * q^6. By dismissing all but one arrangement of exponents, the mechanism fails to identify all possible values of n.
